_fixture: Synthetic example for UI development; not real data. Truncated to 4 daily points.

algorithm.description: Trailing 7-day Pearson correlation between the latest wind forecast and the imbalance price.

param_descriptions.window_periods: Trailing window length in settlement periods (336 = 7 days)
param_descriptions.min_periods: Fewest non-missing periods in the window for a value; fewer gives null

algorithm.limitations: Descriptive statistic over past periods. Not a forecast, a probability or evidence of cause.
